Tips for Managing Feeds

• Timeout errors: The feed server is too slow. Consider removing these feeds.

• RSSHub feeds: These may be rate-limited or unreliable. Look for native RSS feeds from the source.

• 404 errors: The feed URL no longer exists. Remove these feeds.

• Failed feeds: Check if the website still provides an RSS feed, or look for alternatives.

• Slow response times: Feeds taking >5s may slow down your app. Consider removing them.
